Kicking off Day 1 of our 15th annual farm tour at Crabapple Farm in Chesterfield!

Sales from nutrition assistance programs like HIP and SNAP make small local farms like these viable—benefits that are essential to not just those in need, but to the entire community.

Check out Tevis and Rachel’s fresh produce at the Northampton farmers market on Tuesdays!

I heard all day from local farmers about the challenges and uncertainties they’re facing. For young family farms like Bardwell Farm, the loss of business because of Trump’s cruel cuts to nutrition programs has been particularly difficult.

To ensure America’s food security for generations to come, we must step up our investment in young farmers. Harrison and the folks at Bardwell sell fantastic fresh produce—I hope you’ll join me in supporting our next generation of farmers!

Republicans clearly flunked civics in high school.

Undocumented immigrants CAN'T get Medicare, Medicaid, or healthcare tax credits. It’s against the law.

These guys lie because the facts are not on their side.

The government shuts down tonight at midnight.

Republicans just held a 2 minute pro forma session.

Democrats came ready to stop a shutdown & prevent healthcare premiums from skyrocketing.

One Republican bothered to show up.

If this shutdown were about giving another tax break to billionaires, Republicans would be working night & day to get a funding deal done.

But because it’s working families who are about to see their healthcare premiums skyrockets, Republicans are at home sitting on the couch.

Republicans are lying—here’s the truth.

The Republican budget means that healthcare premiums will MORE THAN DOUBLE next year for millions of Americans.

They claim Democrats want undocumented immigrants to get Medicare & Medicaid. That is a PROPOSTEROUS LIE. They know that is already illegal under federal law, and they are lying to turn this into a debate about something that does not happen.

Here’s the question they REFUSE to answer: WHO IS ACTUALLY HURT IF THEIR BUDGET PASSES?

Answer: THE AMERICAN PEOPLE!

That is their strategy. Lie, deflect, and distract you with BS about immigrants to turn your attention away from the fact that they don’t think working families deserve affordable healthcare. It’s sick.
